mockDataWarning: All current assessments are interface demonstrations and require scholarly review.

claimBasis.direct-visualization-evidence: Studies directly examine the visualization case, design feature, task or closely matching outcome.
claimBasis.psychology-transfer: The claim transfers evidence from a psychological phenomenon not yet directly validated in the visualization context.
claimBasis.theoretical-interpretation: The relationship is justified mainly through theory or conceptual interpretation.
claimBasis.curator-hypothesis: The relationship is proposed by a curator as a candidate for investigation.

relationshipConfidence.high: Converging, directly applicable and methodologically credible evidence.
relationshipConfidence.moderate: Relevant evidence exists but has limitations, indirectness or incomplete replication.
relationshipConfidence.low: Evidence is sparse, indirect, preliminary or strongly context-dependent.
relationshipConfidence.unassessed: The relationship has not yet received a structured confidence assessment.

synthesisStatus.consistent: The reviewed records broadly support the same conclusion.
synthesisStatus.mixed: The reviewed records show different effects across studies or conditions.
synthesisStatus.limited: Too few or too indirect records are available for a firm synthesis.
synthesisStatus.conflicting: Comparable reviewed records support opposing conclusions.
synthesisStatus.no-reviewed-evidence: No verified scholarly record has been reviewed for this relationship.

applicability.direct: Evidence closely matches the visualization, task and outcome.
applicability.indirect: Evidence informs the relationship through an adjacent construct or context.
applicability.context-dependent: Applicability depends strongly on task, population, dataset or design conditions.
applicability.unassessed: Applicability has not yet been assessed.

recordVerification.verified: Bibliographic and study details have been checked against the source.
recordVerification.partially-verified: Some bibliographic or methodological fields remain unchecked.
recordVerification.mock-unverified: The record is invented demonstration data and is not scholarly evidence.
